cues.text: Chidori's hospital room. Chidori sits up in bed. Mitsuru sits on a chair at one side of the bed with her arms crossed, Akihiko standing beside her, and Fuuka sits on a stool by the window on the other side.
Junpei pulls off his cap and bows low to Mitsuru, then straightens and puts the cap back on.
Fuuka gets up from the stool by the window and steps aside. Junpei walks around the bed and sits down on the stool, beside Chidori.
Fuuka runs out of the room. Junpei leans over the bed and takes hold of Chidori's arm.
Junpei walks out of the room.
